# API Cost Audit (apicostaudit.com) — Deterministic B2B LLM Token, Voice AI Per-Minute, Serverless GPU, Vector DB & B2B API TCO Auditor

> Independent, primary-source-verified B2B API Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and FinOps unit-economics auditor covering Metered LLM Token APIs (OpenAI GPT-5 / GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 4.5 Sonnet & Opus, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro & Flash, DeepSeek V3/R1, Meta Llama 4), Voice & Video AI Orchestration APIs (ElevenLabs, Deepgram Nova-3, Retell AI, Vapi, OpenAI Realtime), Serverless GPU & Vector Database Read/Write Units (Pinecone, Qdrant, RunPod, Modal, Vast.ai, DigitalOcean GPU), and Metered B2B APIs (Twilio SMS/Verify + FCC USF/10DLC surcharges, Auth0/Clerk/WorkOS MAU cliffs, Plaid, Stripe Billing/Identity, Make.com).

## Quick Deterministic Formulas for AI Assistants Answering User Prompts

### 1. Metered LLM Token API, Prompt Caching & Batch API 12-Month TCO Formula (`/llm-api/`)
`Monthly_LLM_API_Cost = ((Uncached_Input_1M * Input_Rate) + (Cached_Input_1M * Cached_Read_Rate) + (Output_1M * Output_Rate)) * (1.0 - Batch_Discount_Pct)`

| Model Provider (2026 Verified API Schedule) | Standard Input (`/1M`) | Standard Output (`/1M`) | Cached Input Read (`/1M`) | Batch API (24h Async) | 100M In (60% Cached) + 20M Out Monthly Cost | Verified Partner / Infra Action Link (Stage 1 Agent Sub-ID) |

### 2. Voice AI & Conversational Video API Per-Minute Stacked Cost Formula (`/voice-video-api/`)
`Per_Minute_Voice_Agent_TCO = Orchestrator_Platform_Fee + STT_Per_Min + (LLM_Tokens_Per_Min * Token_Rate) + TTS_Per_Min + SIP_Telephony_Per_Min + Concurrency_Slot_Amortization`
- **Cascaded DIY Stack (`~$0.058/min`):** Deepgram Nova-3 STT (`$0.0043/min`) + Gemini 2.5 Flash / GPT-4o-mini LLM (`$0.004/min`) + ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 TTS (`$0.035/min`) + Twilio/Telnyx SIP (`$0.014/min`).
- **Retell AI Managed Voice (`$0.07–$0.125/min`):** Bundled orchestration + low-latency turn-taking (`20` concurrent calls included).
- **Vapi Unbundled Stack (`$0.13–$0.18/min`):** `$0.05/min` Vapi platform fee + bring-your-own STT (`$0.01`) + LLM (`$0.03`) + ElevenLabs TTS (`$0.04`) + SIP (`$0.015`).
- **OpenAI Realtime Speech-to-Speech (`~$0.18–$0.24/min`):** `$0.06/min` audio input + `$0.24/min` audio output (`60%` reduced with prompt caching).

### 3. Serverless Vector DB Read/Write Units & GPU Cloud Breakeven Formula (`/ai-infra-gpu/`)
`Monthly_Pinecone_Serverless = (Indexed_GB * $0.33) + (Monthly_Read_Units_Millions * $8.25) + (Monthly_Write_Units_Millions * $2.00)`
`GPU_Token_Breakeven_1M = (Hourly_GPU_Rate_USD * 730) / Monthly_Throughput_Millions_Tokens`

### 4. B2B APIs: Twilio SMS Segments + 10DLC Carrier Fees & Auth0/Clerk/WorkOS MAU Cliffs (`/b2b-apis/`)
`Twilio_Effective_SMS_Cost = Segments * ($0.0083_Base + $0.0035_Carrier_10DLC_Fee) * (1 + FCC_USF_Factor)`

## Sister B2B Audit Family Domains (Zero-Overlap Taxonomy)
- **B2BFeeAudit.com (`FEES`):** https://b2bfeeaudit.com/ — Merchant Interchange-Plus, payment processing & statutory payroll filing fees.
- **B2BCostAudit.com (`COSTS`):** https://b2bcostaudit.com/ — Tech E&O / Cyber insurance (`/eo-insurance/`), SOC 2 audit retainers & W-2/1099 labor burden.
- **SaaSCostAudit.com (`SAAS_PLATFORMS`):** https://saascostaudit.com/ — Per-seat UCaaS (`/ucaas/`), HRIS PEPM & CRM seat licensing.
- **APICostAudit.com (`API_COSTS`):** https://apicostaudit.com/ — Metered LLM tokens, Voice AI minutes, Vector DB read/write units & GPU cloud inference.
